integrity: Full deterministic search and two standalone implementations with corresponding outputs included in package.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration is limited to \(C_3\square C_8\); ordinary rather than total/dual/fault-tolerant visibility. Maximum cardinality nine is previously known. Historical priority provisional; no general even-width theorem asserted.
title: Exact mutual-visibility and maximal-set census of the triangular eight-torus
